notes.title: Abnormality Development Preview
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Steam Community,[/h1]

A few days ago, we announced a major update coming very soon. I’ve been working tirelessly, day and night, to get this update ready for release.

I’d love to showcase some of the exciting new features and improvements you can expect.

There are several new mechanics and features, along with a whole lot of polishing.

[h2]New Screenshots[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148228/18e5ef27d3439742d05e2f5d83683c3ba0da0ded.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148228/c9806ee0b3ef67fd17bc1e9b54869b161167751e.png[/img]
As you may notice, one of the players is holding a salt item, just one of the many new tools you’ll have at your disposal for hunting ghosts.

You might also see that it’s daytime in these screenshots. Don’t worry, I haven’t removed the night or turned the game into a non-horror experience. This is actually one of the newly introduced mechanics, and you’ll see how it impacts gameplay once you dive into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148228/dbf1fe8a197e7d6119aa5753695ac6549c5b1447.png[/img]
The long-awaited fix for holding items in third-person is finally here, no more floating objects!

All animations have been readjusted for a smoother and more immersive experience, and we’ve also introduced a brand-new hand model.

Here are some of the new item-holding animations:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148228/30ce614a6f6b477004590e1d50e43b00f483c982.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148228/6ffcaa1fa7c624c4cf9b97fa19cb211b21324710.png[/img]

We’ve also rebuilt sections of every map and completely revamped the lobby.

With the introduction of reflections, we’ve upgraded the engine and implemented screen space reflections. Metallic surfaces will now feature realistic reflections, enhancing the overall visual quality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148228/5d033d933b7b5de8e0b5bf03962d64687b4a79b6.png[/img]

That’s everything I have to show for now! I hope you’re just as excited as I am to jump back into Abnormality, experience all the new mechanics, enjoy the polish, and immerse yourself in an overall improved experience.

We’ll be celebrating the new update with some massive announcements in our Discord, join us at https://discord.gg/nightmarestudios.

Cheers,
Nightmare Studios

notes.title: Abnormality Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hi, Steam Community![/h1]

We know it's been quiet here for the past couple of months, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

If you've been following our Discord, you're probably already aware that we encountered several issues after upgrading our studio equipment, including some project corruption.

However, we managed to get things back on track a couple of weeks ago, and I've been actively redeveloping all core systems from scratch. This redevelopment aims to provide a smoother experience, guided by the feedback and reviews we've received from all of you.

[b]We're excited to announce that a major update will be released in just a few days, and we hope you're as eager as we are![/b]

In the meantime, you can join our new Discord server:
[url=https://discord.gg/nightmarestudios]https://discord.gg/nightmarestudios[/url]

Cheers,
Nightmare Studios

notes.title: New Trophy, Weekly Tasks & Early Customization | v0.2.2.0
notes.content:
[b][h1]Added[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Early Access Player Customization, this is a feature that there will be added more to in the future like unlockable cosmetics, etc. You can customize your hats right now by entering the clothing rack in the lobby by the campfire.
[*] A new obtainable overkill challenge trophy
[*] First set of 5 weekly tasks available for money & XP.
[/list]

[b][h1]Player Customization[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] All players have received 9 free hat cosmetics. More unlockable cosmetics will be added in the coming days as we expand this system.
[/list]

[b][h1]Changes[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Removed Halloween Decoration
[/list]

[b][h1]Improvements[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a XP section under your level where you can see how much XP you currently have and how much more you need.
[*] Updated the general laptop widgets to have a larger screen.
[*] Dead players can now open hiding spots.
[*] Added more hunting sounds for the ghost.
[*] Redesigned the look of the geddit locations forum.
[*] It now shows above the start expedition button how many players that needs to ready up.
[*] Made Crazy Clown Carnival less dense with the fog.
[/list]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the leveling system not resetting XP so it was easier to level up.
[*] Fixed a bug where certain achievements could not be obtained.
[*] Fixed a bug where at certain scenarios the journal wouldn't save the text.
[*] Fixed a bug where the insects roaming the house might have been lagging and rubber banding for clients.
[*] Fixed a bug where leveling up multiple times at once could reset your XP instead of accumulating it correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Crazy Clown Carnival map would be way too dense to see anything.
[/list]

[h3]We are aware of an issue that may cause drastic FPS drops after adding a large number of different items, and we are actively investigating it.[/h3]

[h2]This is the last patch note before our content update on November 3rd. See you then! In the meantime, feel free to leave suggestions, we appreciate it![/h2]

notes.title: ABNORMALITY RELEASES
notes.content:
[h1]ABNORMALITY RELEASES[/h1]

The time is here, Abnormality is now officially released into early access! The game releases with a 10% discount so now is a good time to get a hold of the game! We take this moment to remind those that Abnormality is in an early access state this means that while we've worked hard to deliver a smooth gameplay experience, some bugs and issues may still pop up. But don't worry! Your feedback during this phase will be instrumental in helping us fine-tune Abnormality to its full potential. 

Please note that there is a KNOWN BUG that is impacting buying of items, so we have momentarily disabled the function. We aim to have this back working with an update to the game in the next 6 HOURS. There is a major content update planned with Achievements, 2 new maps, optional objectives and much more in the next 24 hours. - items that we had to leave out of the main game due to this bug. 

We are so excited to watch you play the game, hope you have a great time with it! 

Have a great evening and happy ghost hunting!

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Nightmare Studios

Cheers,
